description:
pkix-path/src/lib.rs lines 1535 and 1576: The EcdsaP256Verifier::verify_signature and RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier::verify_signature bodies contain use declarations after executable statements (the OID guard check):

EcdsaP256Verifier (line 1531-1535):
  if algorithm.oid != OID_ECDSA_P256_SHA256 { return Err(...) }
  use p256::ecdsa::{...};   // item after statement

Clippy pedantic fires: 'adding items after statements is confusing, since items exist from the start of the scope'

Fix: move the use declarations to the top of the function body (before the oid guard). This is a readability issue — items are actually hoisted to the scope's start by the compiler regardless, but placing use after an early return can confuse readers who scan top-down.

Same pattern in RsaPkcs1v15Sha256Verifier::verify_signature (line ~1576).
title: use declarations inside verify_signature function bodies (items_after_statements)
